notes: This minor release requires Bifrost 0.15.1 or later and depends exactly on bifrost.public.packs 0.10.0. It adds the new bifrost.rust-generic 0.1.0 pack and two opt-in policies in bifrost.security 2.2.0. bifrost.rust-generic holds four note-severity review prompts derived from public Rust bug fixes, enabled by default: bifrost.rust.command-output-unwrap (.unwrap() on a call named output in build.rs), bifrost.rust.filesystem-expect (.expect() on a call named read_dir or remove_file outside common test code), bifrost.rust.home-env-expect (.expect() on an env read of HOME or USERPROFILE) and bifrost.rust.sleep-before-try-recv (a sleep call and a try_recv call in one callable, without proving their order). They match by call name, not by proven standard-library identity, and require only structural-match. bifrost.security.rust.cargo-ssh-git-host-key-unverified (CVE-2022-46176) reports a locked git+ssh Cargo dependency in a package whose rust-toolchain file pins a release before 1.66.1; an unpinned toolchain, a missing Cargo.lock or a workspace .cargo/config.toml leaves the run inconclusive, and ambient Cargo and git configuration is not read (bifrost-dev#9902). It uses the rust-toolchain dependency evidence that Bifrost 0.15.1 introduced; no capability name covers dependency evidence, so it declares none, and Bifrost 0.15.0 rejects it at validation. bifrost.security.go.gob-decode-network-input (CVE-2024-34156) reports network connections from net.Dial, net.DialTimeout and net.Listener.Accept that reach gob.NewDecoder, on any Go toolchain. It needs the packs 0.10.0 gob and net 2.1.0 models and Bifrost 0.15.1's binding of calls through model-declared interfaces. Runs that reach Decoder.Decode are inconclusive (bifrost-dev#9907), though its findings stay definite. All other policies, IDs and consumer requirements are unchanged from rules 0.9.1. This release does not qualify the full policy set or imply complete analysis.
